raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 15 raw_transactions rows with status 'REVERSAL' carry orig_txn_id links to original transactions, but silver_transactions keeps only status 'POSTED' and never applies those reversals, so the reversed originals stay in the totals and inflate the gold tables. The fix is to exclude any POSTED transaction that a REVERSAL row points to, using NOT EXISTS because orig_txn_id contains nulls.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions v WHERE v.status = 'REVERSAL' AND v.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id);"}}
